name: totto
description: ToTTo is a table-to-text generation benchmark where systems must generate a concise, fluent, and factually consistent utterance describing selected information from a Wikipedia table given a content selection specification. It measures content selection, faithful verbalization, and natural language generation from structured table inputs.
evaluation_method: BLEU (and other NLG metrics / human evaluation for factuality)
typical_sota_score: ≈30–50 BLEU (varies with model and evaluation details)
reputation: Well-known and widely used in the NLP community for table-to-text generation and fidelity/factuality evaluation.
